== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[On The Hunt (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-05-On_The_Hunt.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-onthehunt-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip (2013) show the original words (see [[On The Hunt]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); 12 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game, may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At the end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch R8-U run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
